decision.reason: Opacity/blend mechanics require arbitrary mode and alpha choices, and the physically valid natural 75->76 view is not uniquely stronger than forced or non-physical page-76 controls. The active Y/K state stream is visual validation only and still lacks source-backed unit/order wording.
decision.nextMove: Keep held-to-light outputs as visual source-review panels. The best next move remains distinct physical/original-layout source validation or raw clue wording that names the extraction unit, order, or transform.
